name: Tengah Island Conservation (TIC)
summary: Builds a resilient island ecosystem around Pulau Tengah and the Mersing islands that protects threatened species and supports local communities.
programmes: Turtle, coral reef and seagrass habitat monitoring
beneficiaries: Hawksbill and green turtles, reefs and seagrass of the Mersing islands; island communities and students

organisation.founded: 2015 (as Batu Batu resort conservation unit; full NGO by 2019)
organisation.founders: Founded and partly funded by Batu Batu resort (no individuals named)
organisation.accounts: Annual Report 2025 (https://tinyurl.com/TICAnnualReport2025) and Impact Report 2024 (https://heyzine.com/flip-book/1732500b93.html) public; contents not machine-readable; audited accounts not public

contact.address: Long Beach, Pulau Tengah, 86800 Mersing, Johor, Malaysia

live.note: YouTube channel and TikTok account linked from website (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkwdRwiKb4zYn6-lZ_78asA); no live streaming found

donationsToday: Online via Give.Asia (tengahislandconservation.give.asia); Adopt a Nest; corporate partnerships
